title: Can Claude replace Sortly? 21/21 checks, 63 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Sortly alternative, an inventory tracker with quantities per location, QR labels, low stock alerts, purchase orders and blind stock counts, from one written spec: all 21 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 63 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:50): https://youtu.be/mRltqI-Tl2c
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/inventory-tracker
Sortly pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/sortly

Sortly prices, billed monthly: Free for 100 items and 1 user license; Advanced $49, Ultra $149 and Premium $299 a month with 2, 5 and 8 user licenses; purchase orders and stock counts start on Ultra (sortly.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
